slides.title: POV: you stop cleaning by room and start cleaning by side quest
Quest: the dish hunt
slides.body: Walk the house with one goal. Find every cup and plate. Done when the sink has them all.

slides.title: Quest: the laundry sweep
slides.body: One basket, every room, only clothes. Ignore everything else. It's allowed.

slides.title: Quest: trash run
slides.body: Grab a bag and collect only trash. Wrappers, receipts, empty boxes. Fast and oddly satisfying.

slides.title: Quest: surface rescue
slides.body: Pick one counter. Clear it fully. That one shiny spot makes the whole room feel calmer.

slides.title: A whole room is a boss fight. A side quest is a win before snack time.
Want 7 days of quests?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
